title: agentcurfew policy
description: agentcurfew.policy.json: what the components that steer AI coding agents in a project may be.

$schema.description: The address of this schema, for editors.

failOn.description: Default --fail-on of agentcurfew scan: the lowest level that makes it exit with 1. The flag wins over it.

allowSources.description: Where skills may come from: the source field of skills-lock.json, matched as a glob (* within a segment, ** across segments). local allows skills that skills-lock.json does not list. When set, any other skill is out of policy.

allowExecutables.description: false makes a skill that bundles programs or scripts out of policy.

requirePinnedVersions.description: true raises unpinned-mcp-server to high; false lowers it to info.

allowServers.description: Which servers may be configured: the package or image a launcher fetches, or the server's address, matched as a glob. local allows servers started from a local command. When set, any other server is out of policy.

denyPlainHttp.description: true keeps plain-http-mcp at high; false lowers it to info.

hooks.description: Rules for hooks and automatic tasks.

allowNetwork.description: false raises hooks that open a network connection to high; true lowers them to info. Downloads that are run stay high either way.

allowAutoRunOnOpen.description: false raises auto-run-on-open to high; true lowers it to info.

contextFiles.description: Rules for context files and other text the agent reads.

denyHiddenUnicode.description: true keeps hidden-unicode as it is; false lowers it to info.

exclude.description: Paths that are not scanned, locked or verified at all.

path.description: A glob relative to the project, with / separators.

reason.description: Why the path is left out.

exceptions.description: Findings that are accepted, each with a reason, until a date when one is given.

rule.description: The id of the rule; agentcurfew explain lists what each finds.

path.description: A glob of the files the exception covers.

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD: from the day after, the finding is reported again.

failOn.description: The lowest level that makes agentcurfew doctor exit with 1; warning by default.
